package.name: nidar_sim
package.description: SIM-ONLY assets for NIDAR: the competition Gazebo world (generated from nidar_config's mission_config.yaml), the arena / launch pad / tfmini / VLP-16 models, and nidar_sim.launch (Gazebo + PX4 SITL + MAVROS). Nothing on the vehicle depends on this package; a hardware bringup skips it entirely.
